race.comment: BEIWACHT (1) multiple Group 1 winner who looked to race flat second up when back in trip for a fading ninth over 1200m in the G1 Manikato Stakes at Caulfield. Assess on the dominant first win in the G1 Memsie. Can bounce back from the rails draw with. SKYHOOK (3) has continued where he left off last prep with the two commanding wins in the Theo Marks and Shannon Stakes. Drops in trip and maps to get the gun run. No surprise to see him remain undefeated this time in. DECORUM (8) deserves his shot at this level after producing solid figures again when rounding them up to salute over 1400m at Rosehill in BM88 class. Held in high regard by the stable and can figure in the finish. PLAINTIFF (13) Group 3 winner desperate for this trip and further now. Got shuffled back in a fast run race when ninth in the G2 Premiere Stakes over 1200m at this track. Likes galloping room in her races and look for her launching late. APOCALYPTIC (7) caught the eye in her two runs back and don't dismiss.
